_doc: Transcribed by hand from the report (fetched 2026-11-27) and its archived copies on web.archive.org; the page's two data figures read this file through mk_article.py. table1: Table 1 plus Appendix 1 (dates are when the weights were posted; sm is the reading; sig and ev are Appendix 1's evidence column). table2: Table 2 in the three versions the archive holds (v1 12 Nov 21:56 UTC; v2 13 Nov 01:55 UTC; v3 from 13 Nov 04:10 UTC, unchanged since). Best estimates in v1 were printed as ranges (lo-hi).

table1.ev: mixed: about 80% Hopper rows inherited from K2.5, about 20% a 148-SM draw (246 sigma); read as a merged checkpoint, not counted

versions.label: 12 Nov, 21:56 UTC
versions.note: 35% utilisation, runs of two to three months; a check on DeepSeek-V3 gave 2,000 to 2,500 against the 2,048 H800s DeepSeek disclosed

versions.label: 13 Nov, 01:55 UTC
versions.note: lower utilisation than NVIDIA's benchmarks, runs of 45 to 100 days; the DeepSeek-V3 check removed

versions.label: 13 Nov, 04:10 UTC (current)
versions.note: about 20% of peak (25% for DeepSeek), runs of 50 to 100 days, rounded to 500; H100 equivalents added
